title: Faces in Flux
statement:
Faces is about the emotional state of being in between — in motion, not fixed.

The eyes are clearly closed. But you can’t tell what she’s feeling. There’s something there, but it doesn’t explain itself. And that’s the point.

Like Presence Dissolves, this piece explores how quickly things shift — what we show, what we hide, what we feel — all of it changes. Presence isn’t still. It flickers, fades, returns.

This loop isn’t here to tell you who she is. It invites you to stay with her — in that quiet space before emotion takes a name.

Soundtrack: “Reconnect” by Adi Goldstein — licensed via Artlist.io
